setup: UPDATE user_chat_channel_memberships SET following = TRUE WHERE user_id = 3

INSERT INTO user_chat_channel_memberships (user_id, chat_channel_id, following, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 3, 2, TRUE, now(), now() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_chat_channel_memberships WHERE user_id = 3 AND chat_channel_id = 2)
